name: Enamel Light
pitch: Glossy enamel jewels set into warm porcelain.
tradeoff: A pale ground cannot glow, so depth has to come from carving and gloss.
fontWhy: Parkinsans softens the mark, Onest stays quiet, and Reddit Mono holds every figure still.
logoIdea: One rounded ribbon draws an R, the trace a run leaves behind.
sliderIdea: Two carnelian beads spring along a recessed ceramic groove.
signatureMotion: Jewels spring into place, then lift and deepen their shadow on hover.
